fields.name: Hermes Galapagos Catamaran
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Charles Darwin once described the Galapagos Islands as being a “a little world within itself”. Rather like the Hermes Galapagos Catamaran – the first ultra-luxury cruise to visit this remote volcanic archipelago, around 900 kilometres off the coastline of Ecuador. Look forward to a once-in-a-lifetime experience that feels even more exclusive and pampering thanks to a crew-guest ratio of nearly 1:1, boutique amenities, and 24/7 butler service.
The spacious suites are designed with a soothing colour palette – complete with luxurious furnishings, walk-in wardrobe, and jacuzzi overlooking the Pacific Ocean. Wake up or drift off to showstopping sunrises and sunsets through floor-to-ceiling windows.

fields.name: Los Altos Resort
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Tucked into the rainforest canopy, Los Altos Resort offers relaxed luxury in the pristine eco-wilderness of Manuel Antonio. Wake to the sounds of howler monkeys, glimpse toucans among the trees, and breakfast with hummingbirds – you’ll be surrounded by restorative nature here. Sip your fruit cocktail by the infinity pool with views over the ocean – or even better, wander down through the trees (or hop aboard the shuttle) for a day at the resort’s own private beach.

Rooms at Los Altos vary from spacious to huge. Each has an immersed-in-nature feel, with sweeping outlooks over rainforest, sea or both. And all are suites offering kitchens and sumptuous lounging spaces – especially great for groups

fields.name: Puerto Valle Hotel de Esteros
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Stays at Puerto Valle Hotel de Esteros feel a little like being immersed in a live-action nature documentary. The song of red macaws may be your wake-up call. Sunsets over the Paraná river will have you reaching for your camera. While the snaking waterways, marshes and lagoons of the Iberá wetlands are the playground for north Argentina’s incredible wildlife. This 1868 estancia is part of an extraordinary eco-system – untamed, rich in wildlife and truly awe-inspiring. 

Puerto Valle’s modern-luxe guest rooms and lodges blend beautifully into their surroundings. They may be close to nature but they’re far from rustic. Some have terraces with river views, others come with refreshing outdoor showers.

fields.name: TAGO Tulum
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Occupying a prime spot overlooking the turquoise Caribbean Sea, TAGO Tulum puts you centre stage on the glittering Mayan Riviera. Jungle backdrop? Tick. Swaying palm trees? Tick. Exclusive access to a stretch of Tulum’s famously white beaches? Tick. But it goes further than that. With its round-the-clock service and private plunge pools in every room, TAGO Tulum gives the classic beachside escape a distinctly personal twist. 

This eco-friendly stay is as sustainable as it is luxurious, thoughtfully designed to blend in with its natural surroundings. Thatched roofs in some rooms and authentic Mayan stone give it a laidback, beach-hut style – while kumaru wood floors on breath-taking balconies

fields.name: Casana Hotel
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
White sands dotted with sun-weathered fishing boats. Foam-capped waves glittering into the distance. Open blue skies speckled with brightly coloured parafoils as the kitesurfers cruise across the water below. This is the backdrop for Casana Hotel, a coastal retreat made for unwinding in style – or feeling the rush of the wind in your hair. 

With a handful of luxury bungalows just steps from the beach, you’ll get to experience having your own piece of paradise. The design blends traditional craftsmanship with contemporary elegance: think thatched roofs and wooden floors with minimalist furniture. Each one offers sea views, with large glass doors that can be thrown open to invite the outdoors

fields.name: The Retreat Costa Rica
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Nature, nutrition, and tranquillity converge in the forests of Costa Rica, where, atop a mountain of quartz, luxury and wellness live in perfect harmony. At The Retreat, mind, body, and spirit are nurtured with equal care across rainforest-clad yoga studios, open-air restaurants, sun decks, and lofty rooms. With sweeping views, resident peacocks, and a transformative range of wellness offerings—including a wellness club with ten luxury rooms, a cutting-edge gym, and nourishing cuisine—rejuvenation is inevitable.

Make the central swimming pool the first stop on your tour. Gleaming white parasols, plush loungers, and vivid bougainvillea lend a Mediterranean touch, while the view remains pure Costa

fields.name: Diez Diez Collection
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Diez Diez Collection is an ultra-luxe hideaway in Mérida, the cultural melting-pot capital of Mexico’s Yucatán state. Sleek and sophisticated, from its rooftop infinity pool to its buzzing alfresco bar, the adults-only hotel is made for soaking up the city’s vibrant atmosphere, as well as the warm Mexican sunshine.

Inside, concrete walls, monochrome floor tiles, leather sofas and sleek wood lend a masculine, contemporary feel to the rooms and communal spaces. Pillow, mattress and aromatherapy menus keep the comfort factor high, with many rooms featuring generous bathtubs and private outdoor spaces. Up on the roof, the invitation-only DZ Bar serves up cocktails and gourmet food snacks to a soundtrack

fields.name: Barbuda Belle
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Resting on the pink sands of Barbuda’s as-far-as-the-eye-can-see coast, Barbuda Belle lives up to its name. This beautiful Caribbean retreat is made up of just a handful of private wooden residences, each set up for the ultimate in beach luxury. Silently solar-powered and only accessible by boat they make the most of the island’s tranquillity, so you can switch off and embrace the natural beauty that surrounds you.
The cabana-style bungalows take their design cues from the tropical setting: rustic and elegant, yet with all the hallmarks of contemporary comfort. Take in the views from your balcony or bury your toes in the sand and ease the days away. You can even have dinner on the beach if the

fields.name: Hotel de la Soledad
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
When you arrive at Hotel de la Soledad, you feel you might have stepped back in time. Guests have been welcome at this peaceful residence in Morelia since the 1750s – making it the oldest hotel in the city. Today, a careful reservation has preserved the beauty of the original colonial building, while creating a luxury boutique hotel that feels firmly up to date.
Inside, original features fuse with modern comforts to create a homey, welcoming atmosphere. Warm lighting, colourful furnishings and original artworks add a playful charm to the rooms and suites. While the flowing curlicue design that features throughout the hotel evokes the natural beauty of the palm trees in the courtyard. This tranquil

fields.name: Bespoke Tulum
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Tucked away in Tankah Bay, the BESPOKE Tulum residences place you right on a secluded pristine beach, while still being only a ten-minute drive to holiday hotspot Tulum town. Meticulously designed to blur the boundary between indoors and out, each residence blends contemporary award-winning architecture and Mexican craftsmanship. Picture sleek lines, subtle earthy tones and organic textures, fringed by lush jungle and the Caribbean Sea. Whichever beautifully appointed villa or apartment you choose, stretch out in luxurious, home-from-home comfort.  

Relax by the hotel’s stunning infinity pool, chilled cocktail in hand, or dip into your own rooftop plunge pool. Rustle up something delicious in

fields.name: La Valise Mexico City
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Of all the hidden gems in Mexico City, La Valise might be the hidden diamond. Nestled behind a nondescript door in the city’s Roma district are eight palatial suites that epitomise elegance, style and luxury. It’s a home-away-from-home – if your home is utterly distinctive.

Each of La Valise’s eight suites have standout – and spectacular – features. Moon Suite is named for the shimmering moon art installation that acts as a doorway. The mirrored bathroom and lounge filled with Mexican antiques make it a dreamy space to while away relaxed days (and nights). Be seduced by Gravity Suite’s private hammock and swing, and its strikingly modern four poster. Or uncover Mexico City’s best-kept secret

fields.name: Casa Simona
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
High up in a volcanic caldera and surrounded by spectacular rain and cloud forest, Casa Simona immerses its guests in the very essence of nature. As you breathe fresh mountain air and sink into the absolute peace of this place, you’ll find it hard to believe that the bustle of Panama City is just two hours’ drive away. With a crystalline outdoor pool and a spa with a personalised wellness approach, this hotel offers a true sanctuary for those seeking reconnection and rest.

As you lie in your soft bed, take a moment to listen to the forest waking up outside your window, before enjoying breakfast harvested from nearby orchards and sourced from artisan producers. Then meet with the hotel’s resident

fields.name: Bolontiku Boutique Hotel and Spa
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Set beside the emerald waters of Lake Petén Itzá, Bolontiku Boutique Hotel and Spa combines the beauty of the rainforest with thoroughly modern comfort. Named in honour of the Mayan gods who offered enlightenment to those who sought them, Bolontiku is a sanctuary where guests can reconnect with nature, and enjoy the tranquillity of the mystical Lake of the Itzá.

Blending ancient tradition with celestial charm, every room at Bolontiku embodies the spirituality of Mayan culture – carrying a sense of deep connection with the flora and fauna of the forest and surrounding waters. Wake to stunning sunrises, or watch the sunset give way to epic starscapes from a Riviera Suite Room, which puts you at

fields.name: Decu Downtown
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Intimate and inspiring, Decu Downtown is a boutique retreat in the truest sense. And while many use the word ‘sanctuary’, Decu really feels like a haven in the core of Mérida – one of Mexico’s most buzzing cities. With a contemporary take on colonial architecture, personalised service and just a handful of rooms, it’s elegant, exclusive and makes every moment effortless.

After immersion in the cultural heartland of the town, dip into the hotel’s inviting infinity pool. Or stretch out in the shade of a tree in the tannkab – the Mayan garden. Within the striking colonnades of the casona, the modernist style flows from the lounge bar to the bedrooms, where clean lines, high ceilings and neutral

fields.name: M/Y Kontiki Wayra
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Calling all adventurers; a new way to experience luxury travel is here. M/Y Kontiki Wayra is a boutique sea expedition that reveals the beauty and authenticity of Costa Rica’s Pacific coast. Explore lush tropical forests, pristine beaches, wildlife-rich waters, and local cuisine, all while being enveloped in luxury on a state-of-the-art motor yacht.

Step onto M/Y Kontiki Wayra’s sleek decks and prepare to be immersed in a sensory haven. Her exclusive staterooms are sustainably designed – down to the smallest detail – to provide a contemporary space to relax while you take in the panoramic views. Mood lighting, warm wood tones, and huge walk-in showers take the nautical experience to new heights.

fields.name: Calala Island
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
As you approach Calala Island, you could be forgiven for thinking yourself a true castaway, about to be left in the middle of the Caribbean. But as you sail closer, thatch-roofed villas and a shimmering infinity pool emerge among the palm trees. By the time you’re greeted at the jetty, you’ll be a willing Robinson Crusoe, ready to begin life on this private island retreat.
On Calala Island, your exclusive hideaway will be one of just four beachfront suites, styled after a traditional Caribbean palapa. With open ocean views in front and palm forest behind, each one is completely private. Spend your days lazing in the hammock or taking hand-in-hand strolls on the beach – after your morning mimosas,

fields.name: La Valise San Miguel de Allende
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
The old world and new are in perfect harmony at La Valise San Miguel de Allende, a boutique hotel that feels part hacienda and part Aztec temple. Once through the ‘moon door’ and inside the inner sanctum, discover a secret Zen garden sheltered by lemon trees, and stone stairways and walls carved with ancient geometric patterns and symbols. Here, life slows – and time seems to stand still. 

There’s a contemporary edge to La Valise San Miguel too. A 21st-century interpretation of ancient style, courtesy of artist Pedro Friedeberg, is the calling card of the suites. There are just a handful, upping the exclusive feel of this tucked away retreat. Beautifully crafted furnishings, textiles and carefully

fields.name: La Valise Mazunte
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Just north of laid back surf town Mazunte, Oaxaca’s Pacific coastline takes a dramatic turn. Tree-covered cliffs and craggy inlets face-off against the big blue, and here, perched on a ridgeline overlooking a small bay, architects Alberto Kalach and Ignacio Urquiza have created a masterpiece of design with a uniquely flowing energy. Just a handful of suites and one private villa form La Valise Mazunte, a breathtaking addition to a captivating landscape.   

The hotel’s minimalist, pared-back design blends natural materials and a calming colour palette. Ocean views surround you thanks to an open-air aesthetic and cleverly aligned spaces, and the steady roll of the waves makes a tranquil soundtrack

fields.name: The Liming Bequia
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
To Caribbean locals, liming means ‘the art of doing nothing’. At The Liming, this leisurely way to pass the time comes with added luxury. Set on the tiny island of Bequia, this boutique hideaway is refreshingly off the beaten track compared to the larger islands. With lush gardens, a private marina and views towards Canouan and Mayreau, The Liming instantly rewards you for going that bit further.
Made up of just eleven private villas, The Liming is somewhere to relax and recharge in complete privacy. Spacious and modern in design, every room is perfectly positioned for soaking up the sea views. You’ll have your own personal infinity pool or hot tub, if you’re staying in one of the larger villas.

fields.name: Bequia Beach Hotel
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Bequia is one of the Caribbean’s lesser-trod destinations, a hideaway preferred by those ‘in-the-know’. For curious travellers who do make it to this miniature paradise, Bequia Beach Hotel – which sits on the aptly named ‘Friendship Bay’ – offers the warmest of welcomes. Settle into ‘island time’, rum punch in hand, and embrace the unspoilt beauty of this Grenadine jewel.

Bequia means 'island of the clouds', but life here revolves around the sun. Soak up some rays as you set your cares adrift in the stunning saltwater infinity pool, or head to the pristine white-sand beach for snorkelling or a dip. A second palm-fringed pool offers cool freshwater dips, or take your pick of shady loungers at

fields.name: ONE GT Grand Cayman
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Set against a sparkling Caribbean backdrop, ONE | GT Grand Cayman is a landmark development bringing elevated living, world-class cuisine and the island’s first rooftop infinity pool to Grand Cayman. With sleek interiors and generous proportions, the ambience is one of pure relaxation. From the moment you arrive to valet parking and a warm welcome, you’ll experience laidback island attitude with a decidedly luxe twist. Whether you’re here to dive Eden Rock’s reef, stroll the cultural corridors of George Town, or simply wander the coastline, ONE | GT is your gateway to it all.

Set over ten storeys, the hotel offers vistas of George Town, up to 7-mile beach, South Sound and North Sound. Don’t

fields.name: Morgan's Rock Reserve & Ecolodge
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
At a sheltered point along Nicaragua’s Pacific coastline, a sinuous river estuary forms a silver break between jungle-covered hills. Spilling into a crescent moon bay, the river flows past Morgan's Rock Reserve & Ecolodge, a sustainable resort specialising in back-to-nature bliss and eco-friendly adventures. Restful and remote, this jungle paradise is ideal for wildlife lovers seeking an immersive escape into nature.

Camouflaged amid the trees, luxury villas and bungalows have forest or ocean views, best enjoyed from the vast swing-bed on your veranda. Sway amid the treetops, or relax in your private plunge pool, keeping an eye out for visits from the local wildlife. Colourful birds flit between

fields.name: La Valise Los Cabos
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Where the desert meets the ocean, and the glitz of Cabos dims to be replaced by empty, wave-lapped beaches is where you’ll find La Valise Los Cabos. This is a just-for-grown-ups world of warm sea breezes, sweeping ocean views and quiet sunrises. And a hotel that’s a sanctuary in its landscape, with casas seamlessly dotted among sun-baked palms and succulents. 

Palapa roofs, dreamily draped four-poster beds and carved wood details are the hallmarks of the hotel’s hacienda-inspired style. Each characterful casa has a front-row view to the ocean, and outdoor living rooms for humpback whale-watching or coffee-sipping. Take in 360° vistas of the landscape from Casa Bali; or lie back in the dappled

fields.name: Paradise Beach Nevis
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Aquamarine sea and utopian beaches is the Caribbean’s calling card. But at Paradise Beach Nevis, you share these idyllic surroundings with just ten other villas. This is luxury on a highly personal, wonderfully intimate scale. In fact, it feels like seventh heaven.
Hammocks, plush loungers and palm parasols will be waiting for you each day on the beach. That’s if you can leave your private residence with its own plunge pool and shady cabana, plus an outdoor shower for a tropical wake-up call. You could dine in and savour every moment, with drinks brought to you by the on-call villa staff followed by a delicious in-villa dinner prepared by a chef on request. Or you can ask your concierge for an

fields.name: Villa Santa Cruz
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Nestled between the untamed desert and Baja’s rippling waves, Villa Santa Cruz sets a blissful scene. Here, stars light up dinner on the beach, evening bonfires dot the shoreline at sunset and Mexico’s natural beauty shines. Take it all in from luxurious Tented Ocean Suites that promise front-row seats to the majestic Pacific Ocean or soak up the land-and-seascape from your private rooftop hot tub, best enjoyed at moonlight.    

This intimate retreat immerses you in Baja California Sur. The Suites and Bungalows are infused with old-world Mexican charm and contemporary comforts. Stroll through the estate’s olive groves and agave field, discovering pickleball courts, bocce games and beehives.

fields.name: Tamarind Hills Resort and Villas
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
A gleaming line of white sand curves into the distance below Tamarind Hills Resort and Villas, perched on a low oceanfront bluff. Stunning views to the north, pristine beaches to the south, with a promontory of modern Caribbean luxury and magnificent sunsets in between. 

Closely hugging the hillside is a collection of spacious studios, suites and private residences with terraces, pools and parasols overlooking the turquoise waters of Ffryes Beach. Great views are guaranteed, while the tasteful interiors reflect the island’s brightness: white walls, driftwood-finish furniture, and ceiling fans spinning lazily. Walk-in rainfall showers, expansive beds, and huge standing tubs add layers of comfort.

fields.name: Roso Guest House
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
A clever blend of Porfirian architecture and contemporary design, Roso Guest House is a chic hideaway in the hip Roma neighbourhood. With an ambience that feels timeless yet very much of-the-now, this boutique retreat offers a restful night’s sleep within easy distance of some of the city’s finest eateries, nightlife, and shopping. 

From lobby to roof terrace, the hotel exudes style. Wrought iron railings, colourful tiles and high ceilings highlight the building’s heritage, while eye-catching art, modernist murals and bespoke touches add a contemporary edge. Whether you’re in a Standard Room or Master Suite, you’ll feel a sense of decadence. Enjoy the vibrant city streets by throwing open the

fields.name: Petit St. Vincent
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
A dream idyll, Petit St. Vincent resort is a stunning Caribbean resort on its own private island. With just 22 cottages providing the ultimate comfort and an extremely high level of privacy and tranquillity, this is the perfect hideaway. Without the distractions of internet, phones or television, the resort provides the opportunity to really unwind and enjoy the two miles of white-sand beaches and the surrounding acres of natural tropical woodland.
The atmosphere at Petit St. Vincent resort is one of understated luxury. Each one of the one- and two-bedroom cottages are wonderfully secluded and scattered over hillsides, cliffs and beaches with breathtaking views of the island and the southern

fields.name: Hotel Casa Huamantla
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Step from the cool, cobbled courtyard and through the ornately carved doors of Hotel Casa Huamantla to enter a world where history meets high-end hospitality. Here, reverence for the cultural identity of Mexico echoes with understated elegance. Chandeliers bounce light around the airy, high ceilinged rooms. Crisp linens, herringbone parquet and carved plasterwork reflect in gilded mirrors. Antique pieces are integrated throughout the hotel – proudly on display and in use – not sequestered behind glass, as they (and each honoured guest) become part of the building’s ongoing story.

Start your day in a velvet canopied bed, waking to the view of vintage artworks and morning sunlight streaming through

fields.name: Wakax Hacienda – Cenote & Boutique Hotel
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Wakax Hacienda is quite literally off the beaten track. Found via a dusty road that winds through swaying jungle, it’s a welcome departure from some of the Yucatan’s busier locales, while still being within easy reach of must-see Mayan ruins and the glorious beaches of the Riviera Maya. Retreat from modern life, reconnect with nature and enjoy exceptional service in this heavenly hacienda. 

The sprawling complex cleverly recreates 18th century architecture, complete with sweeping colonnades, a central plaza, palatial rooms and its very own chapel. But the jewel in Wakax’s crown is the bewitching emerald lagoon that sits at the centre of it all. Swim in its calm waters, enjoy breakfast in the

fields.name: Sublime Samana Hotel & Residences
fields.Affiliation: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Parent Company: Small Luxury Hotels of the World
fields.Hotel Description:
Reflecting the Samanà Peninsula’s stunning natural beauty, Sublime Samana Hotel & Residences is an exclusive selection of casitas and suites facing a pristine sandy beach. Surrounded by green mountains and turquoise waters, guests can enjoy delightful seclusion, a beach club, pools, a gym, gastronomic cuisine, acclaimed Coconut Whispers Spa, and an extensive programme of excursions.

The architect designed casitas and suites of Sublime Samana Hotel & Residences have large floor-to ceiling windows that make the most of the amazing ocean and mountain views. Choose from one or two-bedroom apartments or one, two and three bedroom villas. All are beautifully furnished and have a fully-equipped kitchen,
